title: Modifying Driver Behavior with Callbacks
description: Inject an error and a delay into a driver using a callback hook without altering the driver class itself.

steps.title: Step 1: Review the Hook
steps.instructions: Open `testbench.sv` and locate the `packet_driver_cb` virtual class. Find where `uvm_do_callbacks` is invoked inside the driver's `run_phase`.

steps.title: Step 2: Implement the Callback
steps.instructions: Create a class `error_inject_cb` extending `packet_driver_cb`. Override `pre_drive` to add a 10ns delay and flip the packet's parity bit.

steps.title: Step 3: Attach in the Test
steps.instructions: In `my_test`, instantiate your callback and add it to the driver using `uvm_callbacks#(packet_driver, packet_driver_cb)::add()`. Run the simulation to verify the delay and corruption appear in the driver's log.
